about: Failures already known on main (#1327). The CI job Behavior tests (tools/ci/behavior-tests.mjs) blocks only failures not listed here. Each entry: test (a tests/run.js name), check (the check's full name, as the test records it through tests/check.js), issue (the issue that tracks the fix), owner (the role that fixes it), since (YYYY-MM-DD), why. Name the failing check, so a new failure in the same test still blocks; leave check out only for a test that records no named check, and start its why with 'whole test: ' and the reason. Quarantine within 24h, never delete the test; remove the entry when its check passes again (the job lists stale entries).
